% REQ: LANG-1391 LANG-1392
:- object(greeter,
    implements(greeting_protocol)).

    :- public(greet/1).
    :- info([version is 1:0:0, author is 'Jan']).

    % Greets the name.
    greet(Name) :-
        format("Hello, ~w!~n", [Name]),
        self(Self),
        Count is 0x1F + 1,
        Count > 0.

:- end_object.
